name: M-s3 concussion missile launcher
description: The M-s3 concussion missile launcher, also known as the M-s3 concussion missile and warhead launcher, was a model of concussion missile launcher manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems. The TIE/sa tactical bomber manufactured by Sienar for the Galactic Empire was equipped with two forward-mounted M-s3s, with the bomber's missile port located at the base of the vehicle's central body beneath its sensor array and between the cockpit pod and ordnance pod.
